mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_job_handler (service_name, handler_name, handler_desc, status, last_report_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{serviceName}, #{handlerName}, #{handlerDesc}, 'ONLINE', #{reportTime}, 'system', #{reportTime}, 'system', #{reportTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE handler_desc = VALUES(handler_desc), status = 'ONLINE', last_report_time = VALUES(last_report_time), update_by = 'system', update_time = VALUES(update_time)
